profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer | React | Next | AWS | Node | Express | Python
profile.summary:
I am a marketing professional turned software engineer with a diverse skillset in full-stack development. My technical expertise includes JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Python, and SQL. I am eager to leverage my diverse background and skills to drive innovation and create impactful software solutions. 

My past experience in marketing complements my skills as a developer, bringing a unique perspective to my work. With a background in various facets of digital marketing, I understand the importance of creating engaging and user-friendly experiences. I leverage my marketing expertise to develop intuitive and impactful software solutions.

I thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy juggling various responsibilities across departments with intersecting and overlapping timelines. My conceptual thinking abilities allow me to see the big picture and think holistically about complex projects. Furthermore, my meticulous attention to detail ensures high-quality code and seamless user experiences.

My colleagues describe me as "one of those people that everyone enjoyed being around" due to my collaborative nature and positive attitude. I am known for my relentlessly disciplined work ethic, which translates into my software development approach.

In addition to my technical skills, I have a strong passion for photography and videography. My ability to capture the best moments and skills in visual storytelling brings a creative flair to my development projects.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Manager
positions.description:
Dycom (NYSE: DY) supplies the single most critical resource telecom service providers need: skilled people. We serve the nation from more than 500 field offices and are unparalleled in scope and scale. Our talented workforce of over 14,000 employees provides a wide array of specialty services including construction, engineering, underground facility locating, fulfillment, and program management.

Web Development:
• Work closely with the IT Department and outsourced vendors in the process of revamping 38 websites of the enterprise. 
• Manage the maintenance of all 38 websites, including improving performance, tackling vulnerabilities, and updating plugins and content as needed.
• Respond to and troubleshoot all website issues, across the enterprise with the ATLAS team
• Create appropriate website content aligned with the organization’s strategy.
• Ensure website quality and efficiency by conducting regular test plans.
• Monitor SEO and web traffic metrics

and meets the organization’s standards.
• Create strategies to grow subscriber base and web traffic metrics.
• Ensure full compliance on the website with all laws and regulations.
• Keep up to date with industry best practices and monitor competitor websites.

Marketing:

• Design and implement social media strategy to align with business goals
• Generate, edit, publish and share engaging content on a specified cadence working with
Director and Graphic Designer as well as subsidiaries, presidents, VPs and business development
(e.g. original text, photos, videos and news)
• Communicate with followers, respond to queries in a timely manner and monitor customer
reviews
• Suggest and implement new features to develop brand awareness, like promotions and
competitions

applications

• Conduct secondary market research and competitive research (for app) upon request.

projects.title: Nomadic - Empowering Nomads, One City at A Time
projects.description:
Nomadic is your ultimate travel companion, seamlessly blending cutting-edge technology with the spirit of adventure. With a React frontend and Flask SQLAlchemy backend, Nomadic offers a user-friendly experience. Our Restful API ensures smooth navigation, while user authentication powered by bcrypt keeps your data secure.

Explore the world effortlessly with Nomadic's unique features:
• Currency Conversion: Say goodbye to currency conversion headaches. Nomadic automatically converts prices across the app, making budget planning a breeze.
• Nomadic Lists: Build your dream travel itinerary by adding cities to your Nomadic list. Compare prices, plan routes, and make your wanderlust dreams a reality.
• Community Blog: Share your travel stories and gain insights from fellow adventurers. Write and read blog posts within the Nomadic community.
• Engage with Comments: Connect with fellow travelers by commenting on blog posts. Share tips, and experiences, and make lifelong travel buddies.

projects.title: PetPals - A Full Stack Web App for Your Furry
projects.description:
• Developed in a limited timeframe of 5 days, PetPals features a sleek and intuitive React front-end, utilizing the Bootstrap and TailwindCSS frameworks for responsive design and enhanced user experience.
• The app's powerful Flask back-end, combined with SQL Alchemy, allows users to sign up and create accounts, securely storing their personal information and pet details using bcrypt for password hashing.
• Users can host or join pet meetups, update their profile information, add and remove pets or meetups, and even request one-on-one meetups for a more personal connection.
• One of the most challenging technical aspects was implementing the radius search feature, which enables users to search for meetups within a specific distance using geolocation functionality.
